mode: deep_case: постановка из case/ принята, гейтов допуска нет, сбой стадии ведёт к ремонту

decomposition.json.components: 1–20 objects {id: slug [a-z0-9_-], title, requirements: [FR/NFR IDs from case/], depends_on: [component ids], check_command: argv of an offline check run from a clean copy of the workspace}; depends_on has no cycles
decomposition.json.out_of_scope: list of {id, reason}: requirements not built in the zero-version; key_requirements are not allowed here
decomposition.json.assumptions: nonempty list of {topic, decision, rationale}: decisions where case/ gives no details

components/<id>.md: per component: what is implemented, simplifications, how to check
simplifications.json: list of {component, what, why, upgrade}; every stub or hard-coded decision is listed

submission.json.verify_command: argv: from a clean copy installs dependencies and runs the offline end-to-end check of key_requirements
submission.json.run_command: optional argv: live run through RESEARCH_LLM_* with hard request limits

status.json.requirements: object: every ID from handoff.requirements -> {status: implemented/simplified/missing/broken/out_of_scope, evidence: relative files (nonempty for implemented/simplified), note}

critique.json.summary: what is built and in what state
critique.json.fixes: list of {evidence, fix}, most important first
critique.json.requirements: object: every ID from handoff.requirements -> {status: implemented/simplified/missing/broken/out_of_scope, note}
critique.json.evidence: nonempty list of your own check logs relative to the review workspace
